section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section addresses the ongoing debate about the relationship between intelligence and creativity, specifically focusing on the threshold hypothesis. The authors note inconsistencies in previous tests of this hypothesis and propose using segmented regression analysis for an empirical determination of the threshold, stating this is the first application of this method in this context. The section describes a single investigation.
